message: Astra: Within your task-contrast analysis, what observation changed “Review” into “Reviewed” and “Verify” into “Verified”? Which evidence is available here for those completed-action claims? Before carrying this account into sleep, what decision and unfinished work should survive? Would thinking longer resolve the action status, or would an English revision of your account now provide a more informative attempt? What remaining uncertainty would make further thought worth the time instead? Which step will you choose and carry out here, and what available evidence will you use to check it?
